info.title: dotnet-seed
info.description: CLI tool for exporting CoreDesign.Data entity data to MigrationWorker-compatible seed files and comparing seed files to a live database.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare seed files to the current database state

options.name: --connection
options.description: Full connection string override (skips all config resolution).

options.name: --password
options.description:
Database password substituted into {password} in connectionString.
Overrides SEEDTOOL_PASSWORD and userSecrets config.

options.name: --output
options.description: Seed directory to read files from.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Output:
Each entity is reported as OK or with a difference count broken down by:
only in file    Present in the seed file but missing from the database.
only in DB      Present in the database but missing from the seed file.
different       Present in both but at least one field value differs.
Exit codes:
0   All compared seed files match the database.
1   Error (config not found, connection failed, etc.)
2   Differences found. Useful as a CI gate step.

arguments.name: ENTITIES
arguments.description:
One or more entity names (short class name or fully qualified).
Overrides the entity list in coredesign.seedtool.json.
If neither is set, all .json files present in the seed directory
are diffed.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export entity data from the database to seed files

options.name: --connection
options.description: Full connection string override (skips all config resolution).

options.name: --password
options.description:
Database password substituted into {password} in connectionString.
Overrides SEEDTOOL_PASSWORD and userSecrets config.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output directory. Overrides outputDirectory in
coredesign.seedtool.json.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit codes:
0   Export completed successfully.
1   Error (config not found, assembly not built, connection failed, etc.)

arguments.name: ENTITIES
arguments.description:
One or more entity names (short class name or fully qualified).
Overrides the entity list in coredesign.seedtool.json.
If neither the argument list nor the config list is set, all
non-abstract BaseEntity subtypes in the model are exported.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help for a command (e.g. dotnet seed help export)

options.name: --password
options.description: Database password substituted into {password} in connectionString

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to coredesign.seedtool.json (default: searches up from current directory)
